title: Sum Two Numbers
description:
## Task

Add two integers and return their sum.

## Input

- `a` — an integer.
- `b` — an integer.

## Output

An integer: `a + b`.

## Example

```python
add(7, 12)  # returns 19
add(-8, 3)  # returns -5
```

## Constraints

- -10^9 ≤ `a`, `b` ≤ 10^9
signature: def add(a: int, b: int) -> int
